email_subject: Application for Business Development Representative (BDR) at iPiD
email_body:
Dear iPiD Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Business Development Representative (BDR) role at iPiD. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, web design, and data-driven content, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of reducing fraud and streamlining cross-border payments.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds, which has honed my ability to work independently and pick up new tools quickly. My experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs has taught me to make data-driven decisions, a skill I am eager to apply to pipeline management and outbound prospecting.

I am particularly drawn to the intersection of marketing and sales in this role. My project mirook.com involved implementing structured data and AI-focused optimizations, demonstrating my comfort with modern growth-tech stacks and my entrepreneurial spirit. I am a self-starter who thrives in ambiguous environments and enjoys building systems from the ground up.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, and I am comfortable collaborating across time zones. I would love to bring my resourcefulness and communication skills to iPiD.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok

Dear iPiD Hiring Team,

I am a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. I am comfortable being the first point of contact for prospects and am skilled at building rapport across cultures. I am eager to bring my enthusiasm, technical savvy, and dedication to iPiD. Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
